_comment: Extra read-only mirrors of the same tree. Everything here is added to art.json / mirrors.json and to the site's speed test automatically — so pointing a new CDN at the bucket is one entry, not a code change. These are origins we do NOT deploy to; the r2 origin and the Pages origin are handled by the sync itself.

_example.note: AWS CloudFront in front of the R2 bucket

_git_comment: Origins that mount files out of THIS git repository through a public mirror chain. They serve what is committed to git — the interface files and probe/cdn-probe.bin — and NOT public/assets/**, which is deliberately kept out of git (it is derived from the upstream release package). Each entry is therefore marked coverage=partial and carries its own probe path, so the site can say so on the card instead of implying a full mirror. Statically caveat: only the '@ref' form is https — the '/gh/<repo>/<ref>/<path>' form 301-redirects to http and would be blocked as mixed content.
